pain_point: No warehouse stock available in right size
headline_pain: Why Is Small Warehouse Stock Gone?
headline_outcome: New Units Built for Your Business
primary_text: "There's literally nothing available to buy in the size range we need in the west." Here's why: developers make more money building big. So no one builds for small businesses. We do. Our off-the-plan Truganina warehouses are purpose-built in the 150–500sqm range that owner-occupiers actually need. Brand new, not retrofitted. High clearance, roller doors, dedicated parking. Right next to Princes Freeway and the West Gate Tunnel, 20km from the CBD. If you've wondered why there's nothing in your size — now there is. How long will it last?
description: Finally — someone building warehouses in the 150–500sqm range for actual small businesses.
